title: the universe is created at every point every moment

scenes.title: Seth's cosmology
scenes.narration: 'The physical universe was not born through some explosion of energy which is being dispersed.'

scenes.title: Created everywhere
scenes.narration: 'It is everywhere being created at all of its points at each moment.'

scenes.title: The Big Bang
scenes.narration: The standard story: one moment of creation — then 13.8 billion years of cooling.

scenes.title: What it explains
scenes.narration: The Big Bang explains the cosmic microwave background, element abundances, expansion.

scenes.title: What it leaves out
scenes.narration: Why is there something rather than nothing? And what creates the present moment?

scenes.title: Continuous creation
scenes.narration: Seth: creation is not a past event — it is a present act.

scenes.title: Every point
scenes.narration: Every point in space is a node of ongoing creation.

scenes.title: The psyche participates
scenes.narration: 'Your psyche is being drawn back into itself and out of itself in psychological pulses.'

scenes.title: In and out
scenes.narration: These pulses have a correlation with the behavior of electrons.

scenes.title: The electron correlation
scenes.narration: Electrons are not 'there' — they are events. Their appearance and disappearance mirrors consciousness.

scenes.title: Quantum creation
scenes.narration: In quantum field theory, particles are constantly created and annihilated in the vacuum.

scenes.title: Steady state
scenes.narration: The universe is not running down — it is being continuously replenished.

scenes.title: Not the old cosmology
scenes.narration: This is not the 1950s steady state theory — it is a different claim about the nature of creation.

scenes.title: Participatory universe
scenes.narration: Wheeler: 'We are not only observers. We are participators.'

scenes.title: Creation needs consciousness
scenes.narration: In this view, consciousness is not an afterthought — it is intrinsic to reality.

scenes.title: Caution
scenes.narration: Continuous creation is a metaphysical claim, not a physical theory.

scenes.title: The resonance
scenes.narration: But it resonates with quantum field theory and the participatory universe.

scenes.title: Closing
scenes.narration: You are not living in the aftermath of an explosion. You are being created — now.

scenes.title: Final frame
scenes.narration: Creation is not behind you. It is this moment.
